$comment: The theme file schema (renderer/CONTRACT.md section 10 + Appendix A): the rules a theme file is read and guarded by, as data. tools/gen_theme.mjs reads this with colour.json, space.json, layout.json, type.json and catalogue/contract.json and writes themes/facet.json (the schema with Facet's values: the defaults every theme inherits) and theme_gen.h (the tables core/theme_file.cpp parses and guards with). Values here are rules, not looks: a theme never changes them.

limits.about: Caps for memory and performance only (C48). A file over a cap is refused whole. edge_px: how far in an edge layer may reach on a part with no room of its own (drawn on every redraw); shadow_px: the largest shadow offset (a shadow is drawn outside its box). values: the JSON values a file may hold (the parse reserves its memory once: values x 24 B + the file + the scratch model stay under 64 KB, theme engine S6).

roles.about: Font roles (C49): a theme names a family per role. A type style's role decides its family.

type.about: The type styles a theme may size, each within [floor, the style's line box] at each density (Appendix A type): the box, case and letter spacing stay Facet's, so no line moves (C45). Floors are [1.5x, 1x] px; role = the font role whose family draws it.

states.about: State blocks merge over the base in this order (later wins). LVGL resolves the same order natively (theme-engine design 3.4): CHECKED < FOCUSED < PRESSED < fw::st::OFF.

combinations.about: A part's look is compiled for every combination of its states (16: on, focus, pressed, disabled in any mix): merged = base <- on <- focus <- pressed <- disabled for the states set. LVGL picks each property from the matching style with the largest state, so only a block for the exact combination is always right (on + focus, which a tap gives a focusable object, included). The guards check them all, except pressed + disabled for contrast: a disabled part takes no press (C36).

keys.about: Style block keys (Appendix A Style block) and the part kinds that take them.
caption: face
edges
text

parts.about: The fixed list of parts (C46). keys = which style keys it takes; sits_on = the colour token under it (its outer edges and drawn ink are checked against it, C47); face = the colour token its face replaces (what the component paints there without a theme; a drawn part: the ink the component draws it in, which counts with its outer edges); texts = what is written on its face (checked on every face stop, 4.5, or the part's own text ink); press = the look keys its component changes when pressed (C36: if the theme fixes all of them, its pressed block must differ); radius = the size token whose look range a part radius must stay in; height = the size token a radius is at most half of; room = how far in its edge layers may reach (pad: the part's padding token; height + less: half of the height minus that type style's line box, so edges never reach the content; stroke: leave a pixel cell of that stroke for the part itself; buttons / width: half the caption button height / the scrollbar width; null = limits.edge_px); pad = whether a theme may pad it (only parts with no content: the padding insets the fill and moves nothing, C45).

contrast.about: C47 contrast guard. Every declared pair (colour.json contrast.pairs) of these foundation sections and of every component and screen on the contract (catalogue/contract.json) is checked on the theme's palette, every mode x accent, on the exact and the RGB565 values (the worse decides), plus the part pairs. Part pairs: texts on every face stop 4.5 (disabled selectors: text-mute 3.0); a part's own text ink 4.5 on its face (caption 3.0: glyphs); outer edges of card and control, the knob, major ticks and the arc fill on what they sit on 3.0 (the strongest outer layer counts); the scrollbar thumb on its lane 3.0. Shadows never count.

shape.about: Presets (Appendix A shape.*): each value expands to part blocks; the first value of each list is Facet's and expands to nothing, so a theme that names it changes nothing.

values.about: The words a style block takes.
